description: This PHP source file defines the `InstanceCreationHelper` class within the `OrangeHRM\Installer\Util` namespace. The class provides constants and methods related to helper data for instance creation, such as lists of countries, languages, time zones, and utility functions to retrieve these data based on codes or to generate a list of all time zones.

classes.name: InstanceCreationHelper
classes.description: A utility class providing constants and methods for handling country, language, timezone lists and related retrieval functions in the OrangeHRM installation process.

methods.name: getTimezones
methods.description: Returns an array of all available timezone identifiers with labels.

methods.name: getCountryByCode
methods.description: Retrieves country information (id and label) for a given country code.

methods.name: getLanguageByCode
methods.description: Retrieves language information (id and label) for a given language code.
